bear.arm_topology: single connected tetrahedral soft body including shoulders and both arms

cotton.hole_topology: actual missing triangles; three boundary loops; no faces span openings

geometry.provenance: Original local procedural extension of preserved Velcro scene; torso field, cloth extents and strip textures retained.

velcro.locations: original left/right short-end regions of same cotton mesh
velcro.visual: navy hook / ochre loop zones; activation sides set by config
velcro.model: surface bond zones, no additional thickness or mass
velcro.active_faces: both original +Z faces, meeting as a folded seam

scope: Wrap, join complementary Velcro strips, then sequentially grasp and draw both soft bear arms through real cloth openings.

rigid_pbd_contact.method: position-level static/kinetic friction limited by normal SDF projection
rigid_pbd_contact.applies_to: free PBD particles contacting coupled rigid geometry

grasp_constraints.model: exact local no-slip PBD link constraint on contact-gated grasp nodes

material_response.model: compressible tetrahedral filling with an existing stronger surface edge network
material_response.volume_constraint: J = signed current tetrahedron volume / rest volume; C = J - 1
material_response.multiplier_reset: once per substep, retained across contact volume re-solves
material_response.jacobi_constraint_relaxation: bulk_relaxation / maximum incident tetrahedra at the four nodes

internal_damping.model: degree-normalized axial relative-velocity impulses on disjoint edge colors

bear_shape_damping.model: nonlocal mass-weighted rigid-velocity fit; damp only the residual velocity
bear_shape_damping.degenerate_fit: skip when free-node inertia is singular or nearly singular
bear_shape_damping.material_law: effective nonlocal filling dissipation; not measured fiber viscosity

cotton_air_drag.model: isotropic quadratic particle drag weighted by barycentric rest area

cotton_bending.multiplier_reset: once per simulation substep by material_response
cotton_bending.flat_angle_gradient: finite analytic gradient; atan2 signed angle

cotton_membrane.model: tension-only finite extension of existing woven-cloth mesh edges
cotton_membrane.material_axes: original horizontal cloth X=warp, Y=weft; other edges=bias
cotton_membrane.solver: inverse-mass-weighted in-place projections on disjoint edge colors
cotton_membrane.coupled_constraint_residual: finite sweeps and later bending/contact may exceed bounds; inspect measure()

wrapping.controller: Contact-adaptive grasp IK; prevalidated continuous joint trajectory for wrapping
wrapping.grasp_model: contact-gated local no-slip PBD link attachments
wrapping.cloth_corners: two front (negative Y) corners of the initial flat rectangle

surface_contact.method: mass-weighted cloth vertex/mid-edge/face contacts against the moving tetrahedral bear boundary
surface_contact.coupling_note: Additional sampled surface barrier uses the currently deforming body as an obstacle when scale=0; native particle collisions and robot/body dynamics remain active.
surface_contact.normal_update: cached smooth normal transported with current triangle frame each substep
surface_contact.entry_side_history: Retain the last exterior triangle and transported normal while a sample is signed-inside; discrete anti-crossing aid, not CCD.

friction.model: Coulomb static/kinetic position friction bounded by this pass's compressive normal multiplier
friction.motion_reference: relative cloth/body displacement from this substep's ipos

signed_volume_barrier.model: Mass-weighted oriented-tetrahedron inequality constraint; fixed and link-attached nodes stay fixed. Applied only below the local volume floor; no target object pose.

seam_surface_contact.model: reciprocal unsigned-distance sampled VF plus finite edge-edge contact between the two cloth end regions
seam_surface_contact.edge_pair_policy: all close opposite-region edge pairs; closest segment parameters recomputed each substep
seam_surface_contact.participation_counting: rebuilt every projection from actual active VF and EE distances; conservative target corners/endpoints
seam_surface_contact.all_features: unsigned radial repulsion only at actual finite triangle or segment distance below thickness
seam_surface_contact.history_usage: normal selection only at distance <= 1e-9 m; no side or crossing constraint
seam_surface_contact.restoration: transient cache rebuilt; resume from nonintersecting geometry; exact coincidence has ambiguous incoming normal

wrapping.completion_scope: Wrap, join complementary Velcro strips, then sequentially grasp and draw both soft bear arms through real cloth openings.

velcro.model: contact-gated ideal local no-slip hook/loop adhesion with geometric detachment

minimum_joined_patch.scope: A contact-gated ideal point attachment represents initial local hook engagement. Additional bonds require independent real contact. No full-width adhesive coverage, torsional stiffness, or calibrated load/peel rating is assumed.

arm_extraction.grasp_model: contact-gated local no-slip link constraints; no force closure calibration
arm_extraction.cloth_holes: missing mesh faces, not a transparent texture

seam_contact_metrics.crossing_measurement: not applicable: unsigned discrete contact is not a crossing or penetration test

description.model: reciprocal unsigned-distance sampled VF plus finite edge-edge contact between the two cloth end regions
description.edge_pair_policy: all close opposite-region edge pairs; closest segment parameters recomputed each substep
description.participation_counting: rebuilt every projection from actual active VF and EE distances; conservative target corners/endpoints
description.all_features: unsigned radial repulsion only at actual finite triangle or segment distance below thickness
description.history_usage: normal selection only at distance <= 1e-9 m; no side or crossing constraint
description.restoration: transient cache rebuilt; resume from nonintersecting geometry; exact coincidence has ambiguous incoming normal

metrics.model: contact-gated ideal local no-slip hook/loop adhesion with geometric detachment
